description: This PHP source file defines the class ReportingMethodMenuConfigurator which implements the MenuConfigurator interface. It is responsible for configuring menu items related to reporting methods within the OrangeHRM PIM module, specifically overriding the current screen to 'viewReportingMethods'.

classes.name: ReportingMethodMenuConfigurator
classes.description: A class that configures reporting method menu items for the OrangeHRM PIM module by overriding the current screen to 'viewReportingMethods'.

methods.name: configure
methods.description: Overrides the current screen to 'viewReportingMethods' in the given Screen object and returns null.
